title: BBQ Jackfruit Steamed Buns
notes: This is the very recipe that won The Arbor "Best In Show" for Vancouver Magazine's "Bao Taste Test". To be clear, it didn't win "Best Vegan Bao", it won best overall bao up against meat-loaded versions. This recipe is how The Arbor makes the dish at the restaurant, but you can save time by purchasing store-bought buns.

ingredientSections.heading: Pickled Cucumber
items: ½ long English cucumber, washed and finely sliced

methodSections.heading: BBQ Jackfruit
steps: Sautée the finely sliced onion and garlic in large saucepan with a splash of oil over a medium heat for 3 minutes and then add the jackfruit.

When the jackfruit has began to brown a little, add the BBQ sauce and bring to a simmer. Continue cooking until the liquid has reduced and thickened and the jackfruit is tender. This should take around 45 minutes. You can use it immediately or cool down and store in the fridge for 3-4 days.

methodSections.heading: Cilantro Sauce
steps: Blanch the herbs then shock them in ice water. Squeeze out the excess water and give the herbs a rough chop.
Over a medium heat, in a fry pan with the grapeseed oil, sautée the shallots, garlic, cumin seeds, chili flakes and ginger until the shallots are soft.

Combine the chopped herbs with the shallot mix in a blender and purée until smooth. Season with salt. Extra sauce can be frozen in an ice cube tray to use at a later time. Refrigerated the sauce will keep for 3 days but the colour will start to diminish after 1 day.

methodSections.heading: Pickled Cucumber
steps: Finely slice the cucumber, place in a bowl and mix with the sugar and salt. Allow to sit for 8-10 minutes. Refrigerate until ready to assemble the Bao Buns. They will keep for 2-3 days.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Clean the shiitake, slice to ½cm (¼in) thicknesses and sautée in a pan until just cooked. Peel and julienne the carrot, pick the leaves from the cilantro and cut the limes into wedges.
Place 2 slices each of the pickled cucumber and sautéed shiitake into a warmed steam bun.
Spoon some of the warmed jackfruit into the steam bun then top with the cilantro sauce, carrot and picked cilantro. Serve with the lime wedges.
